title: It Is Well With My Soul
lyrics: When [C]peace like a river at[F]tendeth my [C]way,
What[C]ever my [F]lot, Thou hast [D]taught me to [G]say,
My [C]sin, oh the bliss of this [F]glorious [C]thought!
Is [C]nailed to the [F]cross, and I [D]bear it no [G]more,
And, [C]Lord, haste the day when my [F]faith shall be [C]sight,
The [C]trump shall re[F]sound, and the [D]Lord shall de[G]scend,
artist: Bliss, Philip Paul (1838-1876), Spafford, Horatio Gates (1828-1888)
